findings.title: Message bundles are decoded as ISO-8859-1, not UTF-8
findings.body: verifySafeHtml loads both the file under test and the English source with PropertyResourceBundle(InputStream) (lines 68 and 77). That constructor always decodes properties as ISO-8859-1, but these theme files are UTF-8 (raw Arabic, Chinese, Cyrillic, and so on, with no \u escapes). Every non-ASCII character is corrupted before the sanitizer comparison, so the check does not see the strings that are actually rendered. Violation snippets are mojibake, and any code point the sanitizer drops when it shows up as a C1 control in the mis-decoded text is reported as illegal HTML. Read both streams with an InputStreamReader in UTF-8.

findings.title: Diff highlighter throws when prefix and suffix overlap
findings.body: When sanitized text differs from the original, the common-prefix/common-suffix loops do not stop at the overlap point. substring(start, length - end) then throws StringIndexOutOfBoundsException whenever start + end exceeds the string length, which happens for insertions and deletions inside repeated text (for example value "x" vs sanitized "xx"). The exception escapes the forEachRemaining callback and is not caught by verify(), so the rest of the file is never checked and the Maven plugin fails with an opaque runtime error instead of the Illegal HTML message.

findings.title: Choice-format scrubbing skips HTML inside those messages
findings.body: For error-invalid-multivalued-size and every linkExpirationFormatter.timePeriodUnit* key, normalizeValue deletes the entire {n,choice,...} substring before sanitizing. Anything inside that clause, including <script> or other markup, is never compared to the sanitizer output, so a translation can carry executable HTML in those user-visible strings and still pass the new check. The choice syntax needs to be recognized without discarding its replacement text, and that text still has to be sanitized.

findings.title: Account UI message switched to Java MessageFormat
findings.body: error-invalid-multivalued-size was changed from i18next placeholders ({{0}}, {{1}}, {{2}}) to Java MessageFormat ({0} and {2,choice,0#values|1#value|1<values}). Every other string in this account-ui bundle still uses {{name}} / {{0}}. The account console interpolates with i18next, not MessageFormat, so the attribute name and limits are no longer substituted and users see the raw {0} and choice pattern. The '<' can also be parsed as a tag if the string is rendered through Trans. Keep {{0}}/{{1}}/{{2}} (and a frontend plural) in this file; the choice syntax belongs only in the Java theme bundles.

findings.title: Admin UI message switched to Java MessageFormat
findings.body: The same error-invalid-multivalued-size key in the admin-ui bundle was changed from {{0}}/{{1}}/{{2}} to Java ChoiceFormat. This file is the keycloak.v2 admin console catalog, which interpolates with i18next {{ }} placeholders, not java.text.MessageFormat. Validation errors for multivalued attributes will display the literal braces and choice pattern instead of the attribute name and min/max counts. Restore i18next placeholders here; the {2,choice,...} form is only valid in the server-side theme bundles.

findings.title: Lithuanian login OTP step is Italian
findings.body: loginTotpStep1 was replaced with "Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:", which is Italian, not Lithuanian. Users setting up OTP on the Lithuanian login theme get instructions in the wrong language. This looks like a copy-paste of another locale's replacement for the old FreeOTP/Google Play HTML. It needs a real Lithuanian translation of "Install one of the following applications on your mobile".

findings.title: Lithuanian account OTP step is Italian
findings.body: totpStep1 in the Lithuanian account bundle was replaced with the same Italian sentence ("Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:"). The previous value was Lithuanian. Account OTP setup for the lt locale will show Italian. Replace it with a Lithuanian translation, not a copy of another language's string.

findings.title: Simplified Chinese account string is Traditional Chinese
findings.body: totpStep1 in messages_zh_CN.properties was replaced with "在您的手機上安裝以下應用程式之一：", which uses Traditional characters (手機, 安裝, 應用程式). The rest of this zh_CN file is Simplified Chinese, and the login zh_CN catalog already has a Simplified wording for the same instruction. Mainland Chinese users will see the wrong script on the account OTP setup step. Use a Simplified Chinese translation.
